findings.title_text: Possible s.201(1A) interest on a 194T shortfall for one payee -- 1 tranche -- range pending deposit evidence
limits_text: Books/documents alone cannot establish the actual deduction/collection and deposit dates; challans, the TAN and (for the pre-deduction leg) Form 26A are needed before any single interest amount can be confirmed -- this is a range, not a computed liability.

Tie this range to the quarterly TDS statement (Form 26Q) filed for each credit: TRACES computes s.201(1A) interest from the dates of credit or payment and of deduction reported there. Where the statement reports other dates, or omits a credit, the route is a correction statement filed through TRACES; the interest then follows the dates as corrected.
The s.201(1A) rate used here is a local prototype default (status="confirm"), pending confirmation against the bare Act/notification text -- not yet a verified rule.

No payee return-filing date was supplied, so the Form 26A (first proviso to s.201(1)) relief scenario could not be computed for this row; the maximum bound above assumes tax remains undeducted through as_of.

Taken on the interest and remuneration credited that attract TDS under s.194T (as read here, pending the CA's confirmation of that reading): once the partner's aggregate exceeds the limit, every credit, the earlier ones from the date the aggregate is crossed. The aggregate is gross and a crossing is never undone: a reversal lowers nothing.

Whether this payee's credits were foreseeable is not classified in the client's list of payees, so the maximum runs each credit's tax from its own date. If the work was genuinely one-off, the CA may instead run the earlier credits from the day the year's total crossed the limit: classify the payee to show that range.
ask_client_text: Provide TDS/TCS challans and the TAN to confirm actual deduction/collection and deposit dates for this payee.
If not deducted/collected, confirm whether Form 26A (or the equivalent TCS relief) is available, and the payee's own return-filing date.
